mapper.select: /* CoachingAdminMapper.countStrength */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coaching_strength cs

/* CoachingAdminMapper.selectStrengthList */ SELECT cs.id AS id , cs.school_level AS schoolLevel , cs.lpa_class AS lpaClass , cs.factor AS factor , cs.observation AS observation , cs.`line` AS `line` , cs.question AS question , DATE_FORMAT(cs.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updatedAt FROM coaching_strength cs
ORDER BY cs.school_level, cs.lpa_class, cs.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
/* CoachingAdminMapper.selectStrengthLpaClasses */ SELECT DISTINCT school_level AS schoolLevel, lpa_class AS lpaClass FROM coaching_strength WHERE use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY school_level, lpa_class
mapper.insert: /* CoachingAdminMapper.insertStrengthHistoryFromCurrent */ INSERT INTO coaching_strength_history (strength_id, action, school_level, lpa_class, factor, observation, `line`, question, factor_trait, factor_trait2, use_yn, changed_by, changed_at) SELECT id, #{action}, school_level, lpa_class, factor, observation, `line`, question, factor_trait, factor_trait2, use_yn, #{changedBy}, NOW() FROM coaching_strength WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: /* CoachingAdminMapper.countModeration */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coaching_moderation cm

/* CoachingAdminMapper.selectModerationList */ SELECT cm.id AS id , cm.moderation_id AS moderationId , cm.case_id AS caseId , cm.school_level AS schoolLevel , cm.lpa_class AS lpaClass , cm.x_factor AS xFactor , cm.z_factor AS zFactor , cm.y_factor AS yFactor , cm.path_type AS pathType , cm.interpretation AS interpretation , cm.coaching1_method AS coaching1Method , cm.coaching1_line AS coaching1Line , cm.coaching2_action AS coaching2Action , cm.coaching2_line AS coaching2Line , DATE_FORMAT(cm.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updatedAt FROM coaching_moderation cm
ORDER BY cm.school_level, cm.lpa_class, cm.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

/* CoachingAdminMapper.selectModerationById */ SELECT id, moderation_id AS moderationId, case_id AS caseId, school_level AS schoolLevel, lpa_class AS lpaClass, x_factor AS xFactor, z_factor AS zFactor, y_factor AS yFactor, path_type AS pathType, interpretation, coaching1_method AS coaching1Method, coaching1_line AS coaching1Line, coaching2_action AS coaching2Action, coaching2_line AS coaching2Line, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updatedAt FROM coaching_moderation WHERE id = #{id}
/* CoachingAdminMapper.selectModerationLpaClasses */ SELECT DISTINCT school_level AS schoolLevel, lpa_class AS lpaClass FROM coaching_moderation WHERE use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY school_level, lpa_class
mapper.insert: /* CoachingAdminMapper.insertModerationHistoryFromCurrent */ INSERT INTO coaching_moderation_history (moderation_row_id, moderation_id, action, case_id, school_level, lpa_class, x_factor, z_factor, y_factor, path_type, interpretation, coaching1_method, coaching1_line, coaching2_action, coaching2_line, use_yn, changed_by, changed_at) SELECT id, moderation_id, #{action}, case_id, school_level, lpa_class, x_factor, z_factor, y_factor, path_type, interpretation, coaching1_method, coaching1_line, coaching2_action, coaching2_line, use_yn, #{changedBy}, NOW() FROM coaching_moderation WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: /* CoachingAdminMapper.updateModeration */ UPDATE coaching_moderation SET interpretation = #{interpretation}, coaching1_method = #{coaching1Method}, coaching1_line = #{coaching1Line}, coaching2_action = #{coaching2Action}, coaching2_line = #{coaching2Line}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: /* CoachingAdminMapper.selectModerationHistory */ SELECT history_id AS historyId, action, interpretation, coaching1_method AS coaching1Method, coaching1_line AS coaching1Line, coaching2_action AS coaching2Action, coaching2_line AS coaching2Line, changed_by AS changedBy, DATE_FORMAT(changed_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS changedAt FROM coaching_moderation_history WHERE moderation_row_id = #{moderationRowId} ORDER BY history_id DESC
